verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs show founders can order a 409A in-platform via Equity > Valuations > Add > Request New Valuation. Nothing shows the valuation is generated from live cap table data, is audit-ready, or refreshes on a schedule. Confidence is lowered because the update FAQ describes moving customers to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which suggests the equity product may be winding down. missing for 10: evidence that valuations are generated from live cap table data, audit-ready/defensible reporting, scheduled or automatic refreshes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
